risk.rationale: The only verified signal is F1: a sign-in from an unseen device PH-9900 (usual device LT-6002), rated LIKELY 0.6 and mapped to T1078 (Valid Accounts). The two password-spray-then-success claims were rejected because both IPs (78.187.4.44 and 193.140.10.17) are shared egress points with high volumes of legitimate MFA completions (186 and 208 distinct accounts in 30 days, above threshold 10), so the failures are background noise rather than coordinated sprays targeting this account. No confirmed account takeover chain exists; the new-device sign-in is a weak, unexplained signal insufficient for contain, and not fully explained away for benign. Escalation is not required because there is no exposure or conflicting/insufficient evidence beyond this single moderate-likelihood anomaly. Recommend monitoring the account for additional anomalous activity (new device behavior, impossible travel, MFA prompts, or follow-on actions).
